flashcard_questions.a: System software that manages hardware and software and gives applications a platform to run.

flashcard_questions.q: What does the user interface part of an operating system provide?
flashcard_questions.a: A way for the user to interact with the computer, such as a graphical desktop.

flashcard_questions.q: How does an operating system make multitasking possible?
flashcard_questions.a: It gives each program a tiny slice of processor time in turn, switching rapidly.
A small program that lets the operating system control a particular piece of hardware.

flashcard_questions.q: Which operating system job controls what each account may see and change?
Which operating system job organises files into folders and tracks where they are stored?

flashcard_questions.a: Software that carries out housekeeping and maintenance tasks to keep a computer running smoothly.

flashcard_questions.q: What does encryption software do to a file?
flashcard_questions.a: It scrambles the contents into an unreadable form using a key.

flashcard_questions.q: What does defragmentation software do to a hard disk drive?
flashcard_questions.a: It reorganises the drive so the pieces of each file sit next to each other.

flashcard_questions.q: Why does defragmenting a hard drive make files load faster?
flashcard_questions.a: The read/write head has less distance to travel to collect each file.

flashcard_questions.q: Why do solid state drives not benefit from defragmentation?
Why is compression software counted as utility software?
flashcard_questions.a: It performs a task the operating system does not do by default.

flashcard_questions.q: How does compression software make a file smaller?
flashcard_questions.a: It encodes the file so it uses fewer bits.
The programs a user runs to get a job done, such as a spreadsheet.

notes: 14 cards: 5 term-to-definition, 4 tool-to-job, 5 causal. The five OS jobs were split so no card asks the student to list them; memory management is covered by the multitasking card.
